csharpCode: using System.Linq; using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; public class BootTree { public static string Main() { return string.Join("\n", SceneManager.GetActiveScene().GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(r=>r.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true)).Select(t=>t.name+" parent="+(t.parent?t.parent.name:"ROOT")+" active="+t.gameObject.activeSelf+" components="+string.Join(",",t.GetComponents<Component>().Select(c=>c?c.GetType().Name:"MISSING")))); }}
